GLOBAL TRAVEL AND SUBSISTENCE POLICY

Effective from 1 September 2025. Owner: Finance Operations.

1. Purpose

(a) This Policy sets out the circumstances in which the Company reimburses
travel and subsistence expenses.

(b) This Policy applies to every Employee and to any contractor engaged on a
statement of work that incorporates it.

2. Approval

(a) All travel outside the Employee's country of residence requires
Pre-Approval by the Employee's line manager.

(b) Pre-Approval must be obtained before any booking is made, and a booking
made without Pre-Approval is reimbursable only where the line manager
certifies that obtaining approval in advance was not reasonably practicable.

(c) Where travel is booked through the Company's travel provider, the
following limits apply:

    (i) economy class for any flight of less than 6 hours' scheduled
        duration;
    (ii) premium economy for any flight of 6 hours or more;
    (iii) business class only with the written approval of a member of the
        Executive Committee.

3. Subsistence

(a) An Employee travelling on Company business is entitled to a subsistence
allowance of GBP 45 for each period of 24 hours spent away from their normal
place of work.

(b) The allowance under paragraph (a) is reduced by GBP 15 for each meal
provided by the Company or by a third party at no cost to the Employee.

(c) No allowance is payable in respect of a period of less than 5 hours.

4. Claims

(a) A claim for reimbursement must be submitted within 60 days of the date the
expense was incurred.

(b) A claim submitted after 60 days but within 120 days may be reimbursed
where the line manager certifies that the delay was for good reason.

(c) A claim submitted more than 120 days after the expense was incurred is not
reimbursable in any circumstances.
